description: This file defines a class for validating 'tel' URI schemes used for phone numbers. It normalizes phone number strings by removing unwanted characters while preserving optional leading plus signs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_tel
classes.description: A class representing the URI scheme for telephone numbers, extending HTMLPurifier_URIScheme with specific validation logic.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and normalizes a 'tel' URI, stripping non-numeric characters except for a leading plus sign, and converting 'X' characters to lowercase.
